laws.rule: Haleakalā: a US$1 (about A$1.42 at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026) per-vehicle reservation (Recreation.gov, 60 days and 2 days ahead) is required to enter the summit district between 3am and 7am; it is on top of the US$15 to US$30 entrance fee. Fee-free days do not cover sunrise entry.
laws.heading: Haleakalā sunrise
